summary: Phase 10 (Origin-Edge Invariant -- Statement, Entry Establishment, and the Witness Gate) COMPLETE against the v2 plan. Landed in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean, inserted after modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_mintReady: (1) keysOriginS4 -- the origin-edge invariant, stated as a standalone auxiliary (NOT an S4LoopInv field, matching the plan's flagged design decision and the keysWorldsKnown/worldsContiguousS4 precedent), over the CURRENT branch/acc (no historical b_birth). (2) keysOriginS4_entry -- holds at the driver's seed state ([(0, empty)]), immediate via the root disjunct. (3) keysOriginS4_mono_branch / keysOriginS4_mono_acc -- survive branch growth and edge addition respectively, immediate. (4) blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem_of_boxOrigin and its dual blockedRedirect_diaNeg_mem_of_diaOrigin -- the case-(b) conditional derivation lemmas: given an already-recorded edge u->wBlock and T(box psi)@u in b (resp. F(dia psi)@u), mint-readiness (modalNonMintCandidates = []) forces the boxed/diamond form onto wBlock, via modalFourBoxProp/modalFourDiaNegProp nonemptiness plus S4KeyedHintikkaInv.eBoxOnlyNeg/eDiamondOnlyPos (already-landed Phase 6-9 machinery) ruling out the 'already expanded' escape. These two lemmas land regardless of the witness-gate resolution -- they are the load-bearing half either way. (5) The witness disjunct is RESOLVED via R1 (case (a) -- witness-only, boxed form absent -- never arises as a proof obligation the box-context route needs to discharge; see phase notes for the full argument). No empirical gate re-run needed (R3 not taken); the standing termination-vs-completeness central prediction stays live and unconfirmed, unchanged from Phase 8. One deviation from the plan's literal text: keysOriginS4 drops the (structurally unused) phi_0 parameter the plan's own proposed shape carried, forced by lake lint's unusedArguments linter; fixed by mirroring the existing worldsContiguousS4 precedent, which also takes no phi_0. This is a shape adjustment, not a weakening -- the invariant's logical content is unchanged.
decisions_made: keysOriginS4 dropped the phi_0 parameter the plan's proposed shape carried: the plan's own literal definition text never references phi_0 in its body, and lake lint's unusedArguments linter correctly flagged this as a NEW issue when first landed with phi_0 present (repo-wide lint error count went 1 -> 2). Fixed by removing the unused parameter, mirroring worldsContiguousS4's existing precedent (also phi_0-free). Repo-wide lint error count confirmed back at 1 (the pre-existing Temporal/Tableau/Saturation.lean baseline) after the fix.

The case-(b) derivation lemmas (blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem_of_boxOrigin / _diaNeg_mem_of_diaOrigin) needed one hypothesis beyond the plan's literal three (hedge, hbox/hdia, hmint): heBoxOnlyNeg / heDiamondOnlyPos, matching the already-landed S4KeyedHintikkaInv.eBoxOnlyNeg / eDiamondOnlyPos fields (LoopChecking.lean, Phase 6-9 machinery) exactly. This is what rules out the 'sf already in e' disjunct of modalNonMintCandidates_eq_nil_iff's characterization for a POSITIVE box (resp. NEGATIVE diamond) formula -- avoiding the need to invent a fresh historical-induction invariant establishing 'persistent-class formulas are never in e', since that fact was already landed as part of S4KeyedHintikkaInv.

Witness-gate resolution: R1 taken. Case (a) (the origin mint's own witness pair, positive, from a T(dia psi)@u mint) is not a proof obligation the box-context route (blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem_of_boxOrigin) needs to discharge at all -- a DIFFERENT query T(box psi)@v ∈ b at a possibly-different source v routes through the box-context disjunct (T(box psi)@u ∈ b at the origin source u) by construction of successorBirthContent's filter, disjoint in general from the witness pair. The witness case's own unwrapped content (T(psi)@wBlock) is already recovered directly by blockingWorldS4Keyed_eq_birthContent + S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd (no origin-edge machinery needed for it), consistent with 'The Corrected Argument' in the plan. No empirical Phase-8 gate re-run performed (R3 not taken).
